summary: A diary records a person in the household or the room who did not take part in the public event.
realLife: A London diarist wrote that his father stayed in the garage with his car and skipped the broadcast, and a Birmingham diarist noted nobody in a pub was listening.
sources: Sussex Library, Mass Observation May 12, 1937 and 2023 coronation-day diaries: https://blogs.sussex.ac.uk/librarycollections/2024/05/02/i-am-not-interested-in-the-coronation-similarities-and-dissimilarities-in-mass-observations-12th-may-diaries-from-1937-and-2023/
